correctness.rationale: For ℓ1, coordinatewise half sum equals max(|xi|,|yi|); its convex dependence on y is maximized at ±ei and gives exactly 2−min|xi|. In the cube, sign vertices maximize the chord mean and the range of signed zi has maximum a1+a2. Minimizing yields uniform absolute coordinates vs signed coordinate vertices. The ℓ1 distance is twice the sum of negative deficits from 1/n; with one or at most n−1 negative components it lies between 2δ and 2(n−1)δ, both attained by displayed modulus tuples. For ℓ∞ distance to signed coordinate vertices is exactly second-largest modulus a2=2δ. n=2 endpoints follow, and A2=2 uses two-coordinate disjoint/opposite vectors.
residual_risks: These are finite-dimensional real normed-space results only; no general dual-space upper bound is inferred.

final_claim: For all real n≥2, the full pointwise BCP antipodal-chord profiles of l1^n and linfinity^n are 2−min|x_i| and 1+(a1+a2)/2. Thus lower constants differ by 1/2−1/n and minimizer sets U_n and E_n enjoy sharp stability bounds 2δ≤dist_l1≤2(n−1)δ, dist_l∞=2δ.
limitations: Foundational 2000 article not read in full; institutional retrieval returned an unrelated paper.
